title: Near-infrared (NIR) luminescent metallopolymers based on Ln4(Salen)4 nanoclusters (Ln = Nd or Yb)

synthesis.procedure: To a stirred solution of H2L (0.139 g, 0.3 mmol) in absolute EtOH (5 mL), Et3N (100 mL as reported) and a solution of LaCl3·6H2O (0.106 g, 0.3 mmol) in absolute EtOH (5 mL) were added. The mixture was stirred under N2 at room temperature for 5 h, filtered, and diethyl ether was allowed to diffuse slowly into the filtrate at room temperature to give pale yellow microcrystals of 1–5 over a few weeks. The same general procedure was used for the Ln = Nd, Yb, Er and Gd analogues with the corresponding LnCl3·6H2O masses.
synthesis.time: 5 h stirring, then crystallization over a few weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Schlenk/N2 atmosphere; diethyl ether vapor diffusion
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: pale yellow solution filtered; diethyl ether diffused into filtrate at room temperature to give pale yellow microcrystals

properties.summary: Ligand-centered UV absorption and weak residual visible emission; strong characteristic Nd3+ NIR emission (4F3/2 → 4IJ/2) in MeCN and in the solid state. Intrinsic quantum yield ΦLn = 0.68% from τobs/τ0 (τ0 = 0.25 ms). Solid-state visible emission almost completely quenched.

synthesis.procedure: ROMP copolymerization of NBE and complex 1 with Grubbs II in a Fisher–Porter glass reactor under N2. To a solution of 1 (38 mg, 0.015 mmol) in absolute CHCl3 (15 mL) were added Grubbs II (1.5 mg, 0.2 mol mL^-1 of solvent as reported) and NBE (70 mg, 0.75 mmol; 50:1 NBE/monomer). The mixture was purged with N2 for 10 min, sealed, stirred at room temperature for 24 h, quenched with ethyl vinyl ether (100 mL as reported), diluted with THF (20 mL), dried in air, and the solid film dried at 45 °C under vacuum to constant weight.
